newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strafor says July orders in line with Q2.
newsitem.headline: Strafor says July orders in line with Q2.

text.p: The chairman of French office and garage equipment company Strafor-Facom said on Wednesday that orders in July followed the same trend as in the second quarter.
"Booking of orders in July has been in the same vein as the second quarter, Henri Lachmann told Reuters by telephone.
Strafor Facom said on July 22 that sales had recovered sharply in the second quarter and the order book allowed hope they would be sales growth in the second half.
Orders at the end of June were up 8.1 percent from a year ago, the company said.
